extracted.name: Bucatini all’ Amatriciana Pasta
extracted.description: I saw a picture of this with a caption saying it was a classic Italian spicy pasta dish, so it grabbed my interest. I found that it originated from Amatrice, a town near Rome, known for its rich, flavorful tomato sauce, and bucatini pasta. I had never heard of bucatini pasta which is a tube pasta a little larger than spaghetti.
ingredient_lines: Parsley and grated cheese for garnish
instruction_lines: Cook bucatini pasta per directions on box. While pasta is cooking add oil to a skillet or Dutch oven on medium heat. Add soppressata, onion and peppers, and salt and pepper to taste. Cook to soften.
Add garlic and stir for 30 seconds. Add crushed tomatoes and red pepper flakes. Mix in, cover, and simmer for 15 minutes. Taste and adjust seasonings.
Mix sauce and pasta. Plate and garnish with parsley and grated cheese. I added meatballs for a more hardy dish but that is not the traditional way.
